name: binhex-nicotineplus
description: Nicotine+ is a graphical client for the Soulseek peer-to-peer network. Nicotine+ aims to be a lightweight, pleasant, free and open source (FOSS) alternative to the official Soulseek client, while also providing a comprehensive set of features.Nicotine+ is written in Python and uses GTK for its graphical user interface.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

paths.name: Path: /data
paths.description: This is the container path to your downloaded files or user created content.

paths.name: Path: /media
paths.description: This is the container path to your media files, e.g. movies, tv, music, pictures etc.

ports.name: Port: VNC
ports.description: Specify the port to use when connecting using a VNC client.

ports.name: Port: NoVNC (Web Interface)
ports.description: Specify the port to use when connecting using a web browser.

variables.name: Variable: HTTPS_CERT_PATH
variables.description: Specify the path to the HTTPS certificate file

variables.name: Variable: HTTPS_KEY_PATH
variables.description: Specify the path to the HTTPS key file

variables.name: Variable: WEBPAGE_TITLE
variables.description: Specify the web title shown for the webpage

variables.name: Variable: VNC_PASSWORD
variables.description: Specify the password for the VNC interface

variables.name: Variable: ENABLE_STARTUP_SCRIPTS
variables.description: Specify whether to run a script located in '/config/home/scripts/' on startup

variables.name: Variable: GLUETUN_INCOMING_PORT
variables.description: Specify whether to attempt to identify and configure the applications listening port when connected to the gluetun network.

variables.name: Variable: GLUETUN_CONTROL_SERVER_PORT
variables.description: Specify the port for the gluetun HTTP Control Server.

variables.name: Variable: GLUETUN_CONTROL_SERVER_USERNAME
variables.description: Specify the username for the gluetun HTTP Control Server

variables.name: Variable: GLUETUN_CONTROL_SERVER_PASSWORD
variables.description: Specify the password for the gluetun HTTP Control Server

variables.name: Variable: WEBUI_PORT
variables.description: Specify the port the application will listen on - IMPORTANT: If you change this value then you will also need to delete and re-create the port mapping to match.

variables.name: Variable: DEBUG
variables.description: Specify whether you want to enable debug logging, useful when diagnosing gluetune related issues.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container

author: binhex
